description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Shaco's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] are empowered to deal 20 – 31.18 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] (+ 20% '''bonus''' AD) '''bonus''' physical damage when hitting an enemy from behind. This damage is affected by [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critical strike]] modifiers.
description.text: Innate: Shaco's basic attacks are empowered to deal 20 – 31.18 (based on level)Category:Debug (+ 20% bonus AD) bonus physical damage when hitting an enemy from behind. This damage is affected by critical strike modifiers.

description2.raw: ''[[File:Shaco Deceive.png|20xpx|border|link=Shaco#Deceive|An icon for Shaco's ability Deceive]] [[Shaco#Deceive|Deceive]]'' and ''[[File:Shaco Two-Shiv Poison.png|20xpx|border|link=Shaco#Two-Shiv Poison|An icon for Shaco's ability Two-Shiv Poison]] [[Shaco#Two-Shiv Poison|Two-Shiv Poison]]'' have additional effects when they hit an enemy from behind.
description2.text: Deceive and Two-Shiv Poison have additional effects when they hit an enemy from behind.

notes.raw: * ''Backstab's'' bonus damage adds to the damage instance of the original basic attack. * The attacks do not deal the '''bonus''' damage against [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structures]].
